zh.title: 美國航空籌辦珍珠港事件 85 週年紀念包機
zh.summary: 美國航空計畫以包機從達拉斯沃斯堡載送逾 85 名二戰退伍軍人、戰時女性工人及嘉賓前往夏威夷歐胡島，參加珍珠港事件 85 週年紀念活動。
body: 航空公司公布的行程包括參訪珍珠港航空博物館和珍珠港國家紀念園區。

en.title: American Airlines plans Pearl Harbor anniversary charter
en.summary: American Airlines plans to charter a flight from Dallas–Fort Worth to Oahu for more than 85 World War II veterans, wartime women workers and guests to mark the 85th anniversary of the Pearl Harbor attack.
body: The airline’s itinerary includes visits to the Pearl Harbor Aviation Museum and Pearl Harbor National Memorial.

zh.title: ACI 公布機場創新獎，上海浦東與虹橋分獲兩項肯定
zh.summary: 國際機場協會公布 2026 機場創新獎。上海浦東機場的 AI 到站行李處理與虹橋機場的停靠引導整合系統分別獲獎。
body: 西班牙韋斯卡－庇里牛斯機場與保加利亞布爾加斯機場並列小型機場組得主，仁川國際機場的李相龍獲個人獎。

en.title: ACI names airport innovation winners, with awards for Shanghai Pudong and Hongqiao
en.summary: ACI World named its 2026 Airport Innovation Award winners. Shanghai Pudong won for AI-assisted inbound baggage handling, while Hongqiao won for an integrated docking and pushback monitoring system.
body: Huesca-Pirineos and Burgas were joint winners in the small-airport category. Incheon International Airport executive Sangyong Lee won the individual award.

zh.title: 日本松山機場舉行空難應變演練
zh.summary: 日本愛媛縣松山機場 11 月 25 日舉行綜合演練，以航機緊急降落後起火為情境，確認疏散及傷患檢傷分類的程序。
body: 參演單位透過模擬事故檢查跨機構的協調與應變流程。

en.title: Japan’s Matsuyama Airport holds aircraft emergency drill
en.summary: Matsuyama Airport in Ehime, Japan, held a drill on November 25 simulating an aircraft fire after an emergency landing to check evacuation and triage procedures.
body: The exercise brought responding agencies together to review how they coordinate during an aircraft emergency.

zh.title: 航空短訊彙整：美國航空籌辦珍珠港事件 85 週年紀念包機、ACI 公布機場創新獎，上海浦東與虹橋分獲兩項肯定、日本松山機場舉行空難應變演練
zh.summary: 本期收錄3則獨立消息：美國航空籌辦珍珠港事件 85 週年紀念包機、ACI 公布機場創新獎，上海浦東與虹橋分獲兩項肯定、日本松山機場舉行空難應變演練。
body: 本期彙整3則航空短訊，各則為獨立事件。

1. 美國航空籌辦珍珠港事件 85 週年紀念包機
美國航空計畫以包機從達拉斯沃斯堡載送逾 85 名二戰退伍軍人、戰時女性工人及嘉賓前往夏威夷歐胡島，參加珍珠港事件 85 週年紀念活動。

2. ACI 公布機場創新獎，上海浦東與虹橋分獲兩項肯定
國際機場協會公布 2026 機場創新獎。上海浦東機場的 AI 到站行李處理與虹橋機場的停靠引導整合系統分別獲獎。

3. 日本松山機場舉行空難應變演練
日本愛媛縣松山機場 11 月 25 日舉行綜合演練，以航機緊急降落後起火為情境，確認疏散及傷患檢傷分類的程序。

en.title: Aviation briefs: American Airlines plans Pearl Harbor anniversary charter; ACI names airport innovation winners, with awards for Shanghai Pudong and Hongqiao; Japan’s Matsuyama Airport (MYJ) holds aircraft emergency drill
en.summary: 3 independent updates: American Airlines plans Pearl Harbor anniversary charter; ACI names airport innovation winners, with awards for Shanghai Pudong and Hongqiao; Japan’s Matsuyama Airport holds aircraft emergency drill.
body:
1. American Airlines plans Pearl Harbor anniversary charter
American Airlines plans to charter a flight from Dallas–Fort Worth to Oahu for more than 85 World War II veterans, wartime women workers and guests to mark the 85th anniversary of the Pearl Harbor attack.

2. ACI names airport innovation winners, with awards for Shanghai Pudong and Hongqiao
ACI World named its 2026 Airport Innovation Award winners. Shanghai Pudong won for AI-assisted inbound baggage handling, while Hongqiao won for an integrated docking and pushback monitoring system.

3. Japan’s Matsuyama Airport (MYJ) holds aircraft emergency drill
Matsuyama Airport in Ehime, Japan, held a drill on November 25 simulating an aircraft fire after an emergency landing to check evacuation and triage procedures.
